widget_rules._note: Standing rules for every widget rendered in this design system. Apply without exception.

arvo_font_rule.BLOCKED_DO_NOT_USE: fonts.googleapis.com — BLOCKED by sandbox CSP. Silently fails with no error. Font falls back to Georgia serif. This is how Arvo disappears.
arvo_font_rule.css_required_in_every_widget: .arvo { font-family: 'Arvo', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; } body, .inter { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; }
arvo_font_rule.arvo_usage: DISPLAY ONLY — main page headline (h1) when large visual emphasis is needed. ONE instance per screen maximum. Never for subheads, section titles, card titles, stat labels, nav, or any supporting text. If in doubt, use Inter 500.
arvo_font_rule.inter_usage: ALL other text without exception: section titles/subheads (Inter 500), body copy (Inter 400), nav links (Inter 500), table data (Inter 400), chip labels (Inter 500), badge text (Inter 500), button labels (Inter 500), metric labels (Inter 500), metric values (Inter 500), card titles (Inter 500), captions (Inter 400).
arvo_font_rule.enforcement_note: Before rendering any widget, verify the <link> tags use unpkg.com NOT googleapis.com. If Arvo is not visually distinct from surrounding body text, the font has not loaded.
arvo_font_rule.ARVO_RULE: ASK: Is this the single most important headline on this screen? Is it large (display scale, 24px+)? If both YES → Arvo. Otherwise → Inter 500.

arvo_approved_uses: Hero h1 — main page headline, 24px or larger, one per screen

standard_style_header._note: Use this block in every widget header. Toggle MUST be a <div>, not a <button>.

toggle_button.element: div (NOT button — host CSS overrides background on <button> elements)
toggle_button.note: Use !important on background, color, and border to prevent host CSS interference. APPROVED 2026-05-04.
toggle_button.css_snippet: .tbtn { background: #4a5d40 !important; color: #000000 !important; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.45) !important; padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .04em; cursor: pointer; display: inline-block; user-select: none; }

source_colors.tertiary_source: M3 best practice — ~60° hue offset from primary (primary H=104°, tertiary H=41°). Amber chosen over teal for industrial warmth and CTA energy.

typography._note: RULE: Arvo is DISPLAY ONLY — hero moments, large stat numbers, primary page heroes. Everything else is Inter (sans-serif). Headlines, titles, body, labels, nav, buttons, inputs — all Inter. This keeps Arvo feeling special and impactful.

display_large._note: ARVO — hero headlines, page heroes only

typography._font_rule_updated: 2026-05-03 — Arvo restricted to display roles only per Dan

spacing._note: 8pt base grid. All spacing values are multiples of 4px.

border_width._note: 1px is the system default for all visible borders. Hairlines (0.5px) reserved for dividers and subtle separators only. Never use 2px except focus rings.

_defaults.button_filled: none — filled buttons have no border
_defaults.button_tonal: none — tonal buttons have no border
_defaults.card_elevated: 1px solid — outline-variant color, subtle on shadow cards

border_radius._personality_note: Outdoor/industrial update: sharp-edged default (4px). Rugged, decisive, grounded — mirrors the angular AD logo diamond and canyon terrain. Softness reserved for dialogs and FABs only.

_defaults.button_cta: xs (4px)  — JOIN AD style, no softness
_defaults.dialog: md (12px) — only place with moderate rounding

border_radius._outdoor_rationale: The AD logo uses a sharp diamond/mountain geometry. Canyon terrain is angular. 4px radius reads as grounded and rugged — not corporate-soft. This differentiates AD from generic SaaS.

elevation._note: Flat-first design system. Elevation communicated through tonal surface color shifts, not drop shadows.

motion._note: Motion tokens for transitions and animations throughout the AD Design System.

logo._note: AD logo provided by Dan — 2026-05-03. Two-block lockup: left = green field + black mountain mark, right = black field + green AD wordmark.

color_confirmation.primary_green: #4c6842 — confirmed match to logo green field and AD wordmark color
color_confirmation.logo_black: #0d0d0d — near-black used in logo mark and right field background

logo_mark.geometry: Three overlapping mountain peaks — angular, geometric, no curves. Largest peak center-right, two diagonal layered peaks left. Creates depth through overlap.
logo_mark.style: Flat, high-contrast. Zero border radius. Sharp apex on every peak.
logo_mark.implication_for_icons: All system icons should use angular geometry, sharp corners, no rounded terminals. Line weight: 1.5–2px stroke. Style mirrors the mountain layers.

wordmark.font_style: Bold geometric sans-serif with slightly rounded terminals on the D. NOT the same as Arvo — this is a custom/licensed display sans. Do not replicate in body copy.
wordmark.implication: Arvo chosen for design system headlines coordinates well — both are bold, structural, authoritative.

logo_lockup.structure: Two equal square blocks side by side. Left: primary green bg + black mark. Right: near-black bg + primary green wordmark.
logo_lockup.color_swap: Mark and wordmark swap fg/bg — this is the core brand duality: green world / dark world.
logo_lockup.implication_for_dark_mode: Dark theme surfaces use logo naturally. Light theme should always show the full two-block lockup or the wordmark-only version on white.

design_motif.mountain_layers: The layered peak geometry is a strong motif — carry it into dividers, hero shapes, section transitions, and illustration style.
design_motif.two_block_grid: The logo's left/right block split can inform card layout, stat display grids, and nav bar color breaks.
design_motif.angular_language: Every element of the logo is sharp-edged — confirms 4px radius as correct. The logo would look wrong next to pill-shaped buttons.

usage_rules.on_light: Full lockup or green-on-white wordmark only
usage_rules.clear_space: Minimum clear space = height of the mountain mark on all sides

svg_files.white: AD_logo_white.svg — use on green/dark backgrounds (header, app bar, dark hero)
svg_files.aspect_ratio: 1.5:1 — use width=120 height=80 for standard size
svg_files.inline_instruction: Always embed SVG inline using the actual paths from the file. Never approximate with shapes or text.
svg_files.standard_inline_usage: Copy the <polygon> and <path> elements from the file verbatim. Set width=120 height=80 on the <svg> wrapper.

outdoor_extension._note: Drawn from the canyon/mountain photography on adhq.com. These are supplemental surface and accent tokens that deepen the outdoor character without breaking the M3 system.

surface_tokens._usage: Use outdoor_warm for hero section backgrounds, earth_tint for feature cards that need a nature feel. Do not use for data-dense UI panels — keep those on neutral surface.

photography_palette._note: Colors extracted from the AD canyon hero image. Use to validate image choices and illustration palette.

dialog._note: 4 variants: Basic, With Icon, Destructive Confirmation, Full-Screen. All Inter. 12px radius for modal dialogs, 4px for full-screen (matches page chrome).

actions.dismiss: text button — primary color, no bg
actions.destructive_confirm: filled button — error color (#B3261E light / #F2B8B5 dark)

fab._note: 4 colour variants × 4 sizes. All icons 1.5px stroke, no rounded terminals (AD geometry). One FAB per view maximum.

states.disabled: container 12% on_surface / icon 38% on_surface / no shadow

filled._note: Highest emphasis. Primary action. No border.

outlined._note: Medium emphasis. Secondary action. 1px border, transparent container.

tonal._note: Medium emphasis. Uses primary-container. No border. Good for secondary CTAs.

text._note: Lowest emphasis. Inline actions, tertiary flows. No border, no container. Reduced horizontal padding.

toggle_on_green_header._problem_source: Host interface applies its own CSS to <button> elements at high specificity, neutralising any background-color set in widget <style> blocks. Using a styled <div> bypasses this entirely.
toggle_on_green_header._note: Confirmed by Dan 2026-05-04. Subtle darker green on #4c6842 header. Black text, dark border.

elevated._note: Highest visual weight. Use for primary content — member companies, featured suppliers. Shadow lifts on hover.

filled._note: Medium weight. Use for secondary content lists, industry tiles, grouped items. Warm surface-outdoor-warm variant available for outdoor-themed cards.

variant_outdoor_warm._note: Use for outdoor/terrain themed content sections

outlined._note: Lowest container weight. Strong 1px outline defines the boundary. Use for selectable items, filters, data rows, member lists.

selected._note: Selected state for selectable outlined cards

input._note: M3 Text Field — Outlined and Filled variants. All Inter (never Arvo). 56px height. 4px radius outlined / 4-4-0-0px filled. 1px default border, 2px focused/error.

navigation._note: Top App Bar (small 64px + medium) and Navigation Drawer. All Inter — never Arvo. Logo uses primary token color in drawer (green light / light-green dark).

small.logo_note: White logo on primary green bar. Overflows bar height intentionally — anchored vertically to bar center.

header.layout: column — logo stacked above brand name + subtext

_logo_standard.note: APPROVED 2026-05-04 — consistent 120x80px across all 3 contexts: widget header (white), top app bar (white on green), drawer (primary color on surface)

chip._note: 3 variants: Filter (toggle), Input (removable tag), Assist (action). All Inter 500 14px. Height 32px. Radius 4px (AD standard). 1px default border, 2px focus ring.

input._note: Always has trailing remove (×) icon. Selected uses secondary_container.

assist._note: Single-action only — no selected state. Optional leading icon.

badge._note: Two variants: Status (4px radius, semantic colors, industrial feel) and Count (pill/10px radius, primary or error color). Both use Inter.

status.outlined_variant: Remove bg fill, add 1px border in dot color, text uses dot color

primary.use: Standard unread counts, nav item badges

dot.use: Presence indicator, unread marker with no count

states.focus: primary 10% over surface + 1.5px primary focus ring inset
primary 10% over surface + 1.5px primary focus ring inset

light.focus: primary 12% over bg + 1.5px primary focus ring inset

dark.focus: primary 12% over bg + 1.5px primary focus ring inset

textures._note: Artistic flair textures — optional overlay layer applied to page backgrounds and hero surfaces. Always semi-transparent overlays, never replacing content surfaces. Cards and UI components sit above the texture layer with full opacity white/dark backgrounds.
textures._usage_rule: Apply as a background-image + opacity overlay on the page body or section containers. Never apply directly to cards, inputs, or interactive elements.

avoid_on: Any surface with text directly on it
